title: Adopt symbolic manipulation animation library as current KP plan
summary: Make the current long-term KP plan a reusable symbolic manipulation animation library across algebra, calculus, linear algebra, and graphical equivalents. Each manipulation family should carry semantic objects, selectors, SemanticTransformation definitions, correspondence and identity rules, visual motifs, runtime and visual-frame samples, graph equivalents where honest, generated problem hooks, flashcard hooks, law checks, and dashboard/search rows.
